statement: Tesla Q3 2026 total vehicle deliveries, published in its production and deliveries release between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-06, come in below the Q3 2025 record of 497,099. Reference: Q2 2026 deliveries were 480,126.
resolution: True if the total deliveries figure in the Tesla Q3 2026 production and deliveries release (ir.tesla.com or SEC Form 8-K) issued between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-06 is 497,098 or lower; false otherwise.
failure_condition: Tesla reports Q3 2026 total deliveries of 497,099 or more, or issues no Q3 2026 deliveries release between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-06.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: At its scheduled 2026-10-28 decision, the FOMC raises the federal funds target range above 3.75-4.00 percent. Reference: target range 3.75-4.00 percent, upper bound 4.00, on the packet date.
resolution: True if FRED series DFEDTARU, the federal funds target upper limit, reads above 4.00 for 2026-10-29 following the 2026-10-28 FOMC decision; false if it reads 4.00 or lower.
failure_condition: The federal funds target range upper bound in effect on 2026-10-29 is 4.00 percent or lower.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: In the Knesset election held on 2026-10-27, lists containing Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Otzma Yehudit or Religious Zionism (the Netanyahu bloc) win a combined 61 or more of the 120 seats.
resolution: True if Central Elections Committee official final results for the 2026-10-27 Knesset election give lists containing Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Otzma Yehudit or Religious Zionism a combined 61 or more seats; false otherwise.
failure_condition: Lists containing those five parties win a combined 60 or fewer seats, or no Knesset election is held on 2026-10-27.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
